attributes.name: animate
attributes.description: Allows you to animate element attributes over time. Animated attributes are updated reactively whenever signals used in the expression change.

attributes.name: attr
attributes.description: Sets the value of any HTML attribute to an expression, and keeps it in sync.

attributes.name: bind
attributes.description: Creates a signal (if one doesn’t already exist) and sets up two-way data binding between it and an element’s current bound state. When the signal changes, Datastar writes that value to the element. When one of the bind events fires, Datastar reads the element’s current bound property/value and writes that back to the signal.

modifiers.name: case
modifiers.description: Converts the casing of the signal name.

modifiers.name: prop
modifiers.description: Binds to a specific property instead of the default binding. Must *not* be a read-only property.

modifiers.name: event
modifiers.description: Defines which events sync the element property back to the signal.

attributes.name: class
attributes.description: Adds or removes a class to or from an element based on an expression.

modifiers.name: case
modifiers.description: Converts the casing of the class.

attributes.name: computed
attributes.description: Creates a signal that is computed based on an expression. The computed signal is read-only, and its value is automatically updated when any signals in the expression are updated.

modifiers.name: case
modifiers.description: Converts the casing of the signal name.

attributes.name: custom-validity
attributes.description: Allows you to add custom validity to an element using an expression. The expression must evaluate to a string that will be set as the custom validity message. If the string is empty, the input is considered valid. If the string is non-empty, the input is considered invalid and the string is used as the reported message.

attributes.name: effect
attributes.description: Executes an expression on page load and whenever any signals in the expression change. This is useful for performing side effects, such as updating other signals, making requests to the backend, or manipulating the DOM.

attributes.name: ignore
attributes.description: Datastar walks the entire DOM and applies plugins to each element it encounters. It’s possible to tell Datastar to ignore an element and its descendants by placing a `data-ignore` attribute on it. This can be useful for preventing naming conflicts with third-party libraries, or when you are unable to [escape user input](https://data-star.dev/reference/security#escape-user-input).

modifiers.name: self
modifiers.description: Only ignore the element itself, not its descendants.

attributes.name: ignore-morph
attributes.description: Similar to the `data-ignore` attribute, the `data-ignore-morph` attribute tells the `PatchElements` watcher to skip processing an element and its children when morphing elements.

attributes.name: indicator
attributes.description: Creates a signal and sets its value to `true` while a fetch request is in flight, otherwise `false`. The signal can be used to show a loading indicator.

modifiers.name: case
modifiers.description: Converts the casing of the signal name.

attributes.name: init
attributes.description: Runs an expression when the attribute is initialized. This can happen on page load, when an element is patched into the DOM, and any time the attribute is modified (via a backend action or otherwise).

modifiers.name: viewtransition
modifiers.description: Wraps the expression in `document.startViewTransition()` when the View Transition API is available.

attributes.name: json-signals
attributes.description: Sets the text content of an element to a reactive JSON stringified version of signals. Useful when troubleshooting an issue.

modifiers.name: terse
modifiers.description: Outputs a more compact JSON format without extra whitespace. Useful for displaying filtered data inline.

attributes.name: match-media
attributes.description: Sets a signal to whether a media query matches and keeps it in sync whenever the query changes.

modifiers.name: case
modifiers.description: Converts the casing of the signal name.

attributes.name: nonce
attributes.description: To enable CSP mode, add a `data-nonce` attribute to the `html` element. Its value must match the nonce in your CSP’s `script-src` directive. Generate a new cryptographically secure random nonce on the server for every full-page response.

attributes.name: on
attributes.description: Attaches an event listener to an element, executing an expression whenever the event is triggered.

modifiers.name: once
modifiers.description: Only trigger the event listener once.

modifiers.name: passive
modifiers.description: Do not call `preventDefault` on the event listener.

modifiers.name: case
modifiers.description: Converts the casing of the event.

modifiers.name: debounce.leading
modifiers.description: Debounce with leading edge (must come after timing).

modifiers.name: debounce.notrailing
modifiers.description: Debounce without trailing edge (must come after timing).

modifiers.name: throttle.noleading
modifiers.description: Throttle without leading edge (must come after timing).

modifiers.name: throttle.trailing
modifiers.description: Throttle with trailing edge (must come after timing).

modifiers.name: viewtransition
modifiers.description: Wraps the expression in `document.startViewTransition()` when the View Transition API is available.

modifiers.name: window
modifiers.description: Attaches the event listener to the `window` element.

modifiers.name: document
modifiers.description: Attaches the event listener to the `document` element. Useful for events that are only available on `document` and that do not bubble.

modifiers.name: outside
modifiers.description: Triggers when the event is outside the element.

attributes.name: on-intersect
attributes.description: Runs an expression when the element intersects with the viewport.

modifiers.name: exit
modifiers.description: Only triggers the event when the element exits the viewport.

modifiers.name: half
modifiers.description: Triggers when half of the element is visible.

modifiers.name: full
modifiers.description: Triggers when the full element is visible.

modifiers.name: threshold
modifiers.description: Triggers when the element is visible by a certain percentage.

modifiers.name: threshold.25
modifiers.description: Triggers when 25% of the element is visible.

modifiers.name: threshold.75
modifiers.description: Triggers when 75% of the element is visible.

modifiers.name: debounce.leading
modifiers.description: Debounce with leading edge (must come after timing).

modifiers.name: debounce.notrailing
modifiers.description: Debounce without trailing edge (must come after timing).

modifiers.name: throttle.noleading
modifiers.description: Throttle without leading edge (must come after timing).

modifiers.name: throttle.trailing
modifiers.description: Throttle with trailing edge (must come after timing).

modifiers.name: viewtransition
modifiers.description: Wraps the expression in `document.startViewTransition()` when the View Transition API is available.

attributes.name: on-interval
attributes.description: Runs an expression at a regular interval. The interval duration defaults to one second and can be modified using the `__duration` modifier.

modifiers.name: duration.500ms
modifiers.description: Interval duration of 500 milliseconds (accepts any integer).

modifiers.name: viewtransition
modifiers.description: Wraps the expression in `document.startViewTransition()` when the View Transition API is available.

attributes.name: on-raf
attributes.description: Runs an expression on every [`requestAnimationFrame`](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/Window/requestAnimationFrame) event.

modifiers.name: throttle.noleading
modifiers.description: Throttle without leading edge (must come after timing).

modifiers.name: throttle.trailing
modifiers.description: Throttle with trailing edge (must come after timing).

attributes.name: on-resize
attributes.description: Runs an expression whenever an element’s dimensions change.

modifiers.name: debounce.leading
modifiers.description: Debounce with leading edge (must come after timing).

modifiers.name: debounce.notrailing
modifiers.description: Debounce without trailing edge (must come after timing).

modifiers.name: throttle.noleading
modifiers.description: Throttle without leading edge (must come after timing).

modifiers.name: throttle.trailing
modifiers.description: Throttle with trailing edge (must come after timing).

attributes.name: on-signal-patch
attributes.description: Runs an expression whenever any signals are patched. This is useful for tracking changes, updating computed values, or triggering side effects when data updates.

modifiers.name: debounce.leading
modifiers.description: Debounce with leading edge (must come after timing).

modifiers.name: debounce.notrailing
modifiers.description: Debounce without trailing edge (must come after timing).

modifiers.name: throttle.noleading
modifiers.description: Throttle without leading edge (must come after timing).

modifiers.name: throttle.trailing
modifiers.description: Throttle with trailing edge (must come after timing).

attributes.name: on-signal-patch-filter
attributes.description: Filters which signals to watch when using the [`data-on-signal-patch`](#data-on-signal-patch) attribute.

attributes.name: persist
attributes.description: Persists signals in [local storage](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/Window/localStorage). This is useful for storing values between page loads.

modifiers.name: session
modifiers.description: Persists signals in [session storage](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/Window/sessionStorage) instead of local storage.

attributes.name: preserve-attr
attributes.description: Preserves the value of an attribute when morphing DOM elements.

attributes.name: query-string
attributes.description: Syncs query string params to signal values on page load, and syncs signal values to query string params on change.

modifiers.name: filter
modifiers.description: Filters out empty values when syncing signal values to query string params.

modifiers.name: history
modifiers.description: Enables history support – each time a matching signal changes, a new entry is added to the browser’s history stack. Signal values are restored from the query string params on popstate events.

attributes.name: ref
attributes.description: Creates a new signal that is a reference to the element on which the data attribute is placed.

modifiers.name: case
modifiers.description: Converts the casing of the signal name.

attributes.name: replace-url
attributes.description: Replaces the URL in the browser without reloading the page. The value can be a relative or absolute URL, and is an evaluated expression.

attributes.name: scroll-into-view
attributes.description: Scrolls the element into view. Useful when updating the DOM from the backend, and you want to scroll to the new content.

modifiers.name: auto
modifiers.description: Scrolling is determined by the computed `scroll-behavior` CSS property.

modifiers.name: hstart
modifiers.description: Scrolls to the left of the element.

modifiers.name: hcenter
modifiers.description: Scrolls to the horizontal center of the element.

modifiers.name: hend
modifiers.description: Scrolls to the right of the element.

modifiers.name: hnearest
modifiers.description: Scrolls to the nearest horizontal edge of the element.

modifiers.name: vstart
modifiers.description: Scrolls to the top of the element.

modifiers.name: vcenter
modifiers.description: Scrolls to the vertical center of the element.

modifiers.name: vend
modifiers.description: Scrolls to the bottom of the element.

modifiers.name: vnearest
modifiers.description: Scrolls to the nearest vertical edge of the element.

attributes.name: show
attributes.description: Shows or hides an element based on whether an expression evaluates to `true` or `false`. For anything with custom requirements, use [`data-class`](#data-class) instead.

attributes.name: signals
attributes.description: Patches (adds, updates or removes) one or more signals into the existing signals. Values defined later in the DOM tree override those defined earlier.

modifiers.name: case
modifiers.description: Converts the casing of the signal name.

modifiers.name: ifmissing
modifiers.description: Only patches signals if their keys do not already exist. This is useful for setting defaults without overwriting existing values.

attributes.name: style
attributes.description: Sets the value of inline CSS styles on an element based on an expression, and keeps them in sync.

attributes.name: text
attributes.description: Binds the text content of an element to an expression.

attributes.name: view-transition
attributes.description: Sets the `view-transition-name` style attribute explicitly.

actions.name: peek
actions.description: Allows accessing signals without subscribing to their changes in expressions.

actions.name: setAll
actions.description: Sets the value of all matching signals (or all signals if no filter is used) to the expression provided in the first argument. The second argument is an optional filter object with an `include` property that accepts a regular expression to match signal paths. You can optionally provide an `exclude` property to exclude specific patterns.

actions.name: toggleAll
actions.description: Toggles the boolean value of all matching signals (or all signals if no filter is used). The argument is an optional filter object with an `include` property that accepts a regular expression to match signal paths. You can optionally provide an `exclude` property to exclude specific patterns.

actions.name: get
actions.description: Sends a `GET` request to the backend using the [Fetch API](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/Fetch_API). The URI can be any valid endpoint, and the response type any of the allowed [response types](#response-handling), or a `204 No Content` response if the response body is empty.

actions.name: post
actions.description: Works the same as [`@get()`](#get) but sends a `POST` request to the backend.

actions.name: put
actions.description: Works the same as [`@get()`](#get) but sends a `PUT` request to the backend.

actions.name: patch
actions.description: Works the same as [`@get()`](#get) but sends a `PATCH` request to the backend.

actions.name: delete
actions.description: Works the same as [`@get()`](#get) but sends a `DELETE` request to the backend.

actions.name: clipboard
actions.description: Copies the provided text to the clipboard. If the second parameter is `true`, the text is treated as [Base64](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Glossary/Base64) encoded, and is decoded before copying.

actions.name: fit
actions.description: Linearly interpolates a value from one range to another. This is useful for converting between different scales, such as mapping a slider value to a percentage or converting temperature units.
actions.signature: @fit(v: number, oldMin: number, oldMax: number, newMin: number, newMax: number, shouldClamp=false, shouldRound=false)

actions.name: intl
actions.description: Provides internationalized, locale-aware formatting for dates, numbers, and other values using the [Intl namespace object](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/JavaScript/Reference/Global_Objects/Intl).
actions.signature: @intl(type: string, value: any, options?: Record<string, any>, locale?: string | string[])

backendActionOptions.name: contentType
backendActionOptions.description: The type of content to send. A value of `json` sends all signals in a JSON request. A value of `form` tells the action to look for the closest form to the element on which it is placed (unless a `selector` option is provided), perform validation on the form elements, and send them to the backend using a form request (no signals are sent). Defaults to `json`.

backendActionOptions.name: filterSignals
backendActionOptions.description: A filter object with an `include` property that accepts a regular expression to match signal paths (defaults to all signals: `/.*/`), and an optional `exclude` property to exclude specific signal paths (defaults to all signals that do not have a `_` prefix: `/(^_|\._).*/`).

backendActionOptions.name: selector
backendActionOptions.description: Optionally specifies a form to send when the `contentType` option is set to `form`. If the value is `null`, the closest form is used. Defaults to `null`.

backendActionOptions.name: headers
backendActionOptions.description: An object containing headers to send with the request.

backendActionOptions.name: openWhenHidden
backendActionOptions.description: Whether to keep the connection open when the page is hidden. Useful for dashboards but can cause a drain on battery life and other resources when enabled. Defaults to `false` for `get` requests, and `true` for all other HTTP methods.

backendActionOptions.name: payload
backendActionOptions.description: Allows the fetch payload to be overridden with a custom object.

backendActionOptions.name: retry
backendActionOptions.description: Determines when to retry requests. Can be `'auto'` (default, retries on network errors only), `'error'` (retries on `4xx` and `5xx` responses), `'always'` (retries on all non-`204` responses except redirects), or `'never'` (disables retries). Defaults to `'auto'`.

backendActionOptions.name: retryInterval
backendActionOptions.description: The retry interval in milliseconds. Defaults to `1000` (one second).

backendActionOptions.name: retryScaler
backendActionOptions.description: A numeric multiplier applied to scale retry wait times. Defaults to `2`.

backendActionOptions.name: retryMaxWait
backendActionOptions.description: The maximum allowable wait time in milliseconds between retries. Defaults to `30000` (30 seconds).

backendActionOptions.name: retryMaxCount
backendActionOptions.description: The maximum number of retry attempts. Defaults to `10`.

backendActionOptions.name: requestCancellation
backendActionOptions.description: Controls request cancellation behavior. Can be `'auto'` (default, cancels in-flight requests to the same URL using the same HTTP method), `'cleanup'` (cancels requests on element or attribute cleanup, and cancels in-flight requests to the same URL using the same HTTP method), `'disabled'` (allows concurrent requests), or an `AbortController` instance for custom control. Defaults to `'auto'`.
